tasks.label: SimCore: Build T-Display-S3
args: -lc

source "${config:idf.currentSetup}/export.sh" >/dev/null && cmake -E rm -f sdkconfig.generated.t-display && idf.py -B build-t-display -DIDF_TARGET=esp32s3 -DSDKCONFIG=sdkconfig.generated.t-display -DSDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS="sdkconfig.defaults;sdkconfig.defaults.t-display-s3" build

tasks.label: SimCore: Flash
args: -lc

source "${config:idf.currentSetup}/export.sh" >/dev/null && DIRECTORY=${input:buildDirectory} && case $DIRECTORY in build-jc1060p470c*) TARGET=esp32p4;; *) TARGET=esp32s3;; esac && CONFIGURATION=sdkconfig.generated.${DIRECTORY#build-} && { [ -f $CONFIGURATION ] || { echo "Run the matching SimCore build task first."; exit 1; }; } && ESPBAUD=921600 idf.py -B $DIRECTORY -DIDF_TARGET=$TARGET -DSDKCONFIG=$CONFIGURATION flash
